body: A compact instruction-tuned language model for text generation and reasoning with a 128K-token context window.
plain_description: **Build English language features that can handle long documents, reasoning, and code with a compact model.** It supports up to 128K tokens of context. Developers can adapt it for specific applications, including through fine-tuning.
technical_description: A 3.8 billion-parameter, decoder-only Transformer language model trained for text generation and instruction following. It supports 128K-token context, is available through Hugging Face Transformers, and has ONNX variants for CPU, GPU, and mobile inference. The README provides a multi-GPU fine-tuning example.
title: Phi-3-mini-128k-instruct
